Index.title: Mwasu hano Alimentation Gracias
Index.description: Ebyalya byinyu ebyo mukunda, bikaletwa mangu kandi bulayi.

omelette-frites.name: Omelete n'ebiribwa
omelette-frites.description: Omelete eyuwasene n'ebiribwa ebinuhene kandi ebiseserene, eyuwene ey'ekyalyo kike kandi ekirunono.

omelette-saucisse.name: Omelete na sosis
omelette-saucisse.description: Omelete eyuwene eyiri mwa sosis esyuwene n'ekyengetse ekiri mwa bulayi kandi ekihunahene.

kwanga-saucisse.name: Kwanga na sosis
kwanga-saucisse.description: Kwanga eyoro eyikaletwa na sosis esyokehene esyuwene, eyuwene ey'erihumula n'ekyalyo.

jus-multifruits.name: Jus y'ebitunda bingi
jus-multifruits.description: Mix eyuwene ey'enanasi, pasio na mangi ey'ekinywa ky'ebitunda ekyuwene n'ekirunono. 1/2l = 3000fc 1l = 6000fc

jus-maracuja.name: Jus y'apasio
jus-maracuja.description: Jus y'apasio eyuwasene kandi eyunono, eyuwene ey'erihumula akatambi kosi. 1/2l = 2000fc

lait-frais.name: Amate amasisya
lait-frais.description: Amate amasisya kandi awawene, awawene ey'eritsuka ekiro bulayi.

saucisses-kilo.name: Sosis (kilo 1)
saucisses-kilo.description: Sosis esyuwene kandi esy'ebeyi, esyuwene ey'okyoka kandi ekyalyo ky'ekihanda. 1kg = 30000fc, 100g = 3500fc, 1/2kg = 15000fc

jus-sprite.name: Jus y'Sprite
jus-sprite.description: Ekinywa ekiri mw'egazi ekiruhene, ekisiba ekisaka kandi ekiruhene mu bikaletwa byosi.

jus-oner.name: Jus y'Oner
jus-oner.description: Ekinywa ekisiba ekiruhene kandi ekirunono, ekisiba mu biro byawo by'erihumula.

jus-oner-embe-energy-novida-power-tangaw.name: Jus Oner Embe Energy Novida Power Tangawizi
jus-oner-embe-energy-novida-power-tangaw.description: Mix y'ebinywa ebisiba kandi ebihuna nguma n'ebirunono by'esyombwa syosi.

canette-coconut-water.name: Amaghetse w'enasi
canette-coconut-water.description: Amaghetse w'enasi Vinut awasisya, awawene ey'amaghetse awawene.

power7-water-bottle.name: Amaghetse w'Power 7
power7-water-bottle.description: Amaghetse awawene awasisya aw'okunwa mu biro byosi.

fromage.name: Fromage
fromage.description: Fromage eyuwasene kandi eyunono, eyuwene ey'ebyalyo byanyu n'ebike by'ekiro. 1/4kg = 5000fc 1/2kg = 10000fc

canette-bavaria.name: Bavaria
canette-bavaria.description: Bavaria ekisiba kandi ekisiba mu biro byawo by'erihumula n'ekirunono.

malti-apple.name: Malti y'epome
malti-apple.description: Ekinywa ekiruhene eky'epome, ekisisya, kandi ekirunono ey'okunwa kisisya.

vinut-strawberry-juice-canette.name: Jus y'efreze Vinut
vinut-strawberry-juice-canette.description: Ekinywa ekiruhene eky'efreze ekisisya kandi ekirunono.

fretins-frits.name: Efretin esyokehene
fretins-frits.description: Efretin esyuwene kandi esyokehene esyuwene, esyuwene ey'ebyalyo byanyu. 1/2kg = 12500fc 1kg = 25000fc

fretins-frais.name: Efretin esyasisya
fretins-frais.description: Efretin esyasisya erisiga e Goma esyuwasene kandi esyuwene. 1/2kg = 12000fc 1kg = 24000fc

omelette.name: Omelete
omelette.description: Omelete eyuwasene kandi eyunono eyiri mwa magi amasisya. Egi 1 = 1000fc

jus-apple-punch.name: Jus y'Apple Punch
jus-apple-punch.description: Ekinywa ekiruhene eky'epome, ekisiba ekisaka kandi ekiruhene.

fanta-orange-cocacola-afia-novida.name: fanta-orange-cocacola-afia-novida
fanta-orange-cocacola-afia-novida.description: Mix y'ebinywa ebisiba kandi ebihuna byosi ey'ebiro byanyu by'omubulayi.
